WITH alert_records AS ( -- 第一步：取得待处理告警，并按权限记录的完整业务键匹配实时权限数据 SELECT a.*, -- 保留告警快照中的原始值，便于识别数据来源和后续比较 a.bpo AS alert_bpo, a.alert_handle_status AS original_alert_status, -- LEFT JOIN 未命中时为 NULL，用于区分“实时记录不存在” r.cmdb_id AS real_data, -- 实际恢复值优先取权限级 BPO；为空时回退到应用级 BPO CASE WHEN TRIM(r.bpo) != '' THEN r.bpo WHEN TRIM(r.app_bpo) != '' THEN r.app_bpo ELSE NULL END AS real_bpo, -- BPO 邮箱与 BPO 使用相同的权限级优先、应用级回退规则 CASE WHEN TRIM(r.bpo_email) != '' THEN r.bpo_email WHEN TRIM(r.app_bpo_email) != '' THEN r.app_bpo_email ELSE NULL END AS real_bpo_email, r.app_bpo AS real_app_bpo, r.app_bpo_email AS real_app_bpo_email, -- 判断实时有效 BPO 是否相对告警快照发生变化 CASE -- 实时记录没有权限级/应用级 BPO 时无值可恢复，统一判为未变更 WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(r.bpo, '')), '') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(r.app_bpo, '')), '') IS NULL THEN false -- 将实时 BPO 的逗号分隔符统一为分号后，与告警快照进行 NULL 安全比较 WHEN a.bpo IS NOT DISTINCT FROM REPLACE( COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(r.bpo, '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(r.app_bpo, '')), '') ), ',', ';' ) THEN false ELSE true END AS bpo_changed FROM user_access_review_alert a LEFT JOIN its_application_access_data r ON r.cmdb_id = a.cmdb_id AND r.user_it_code = a.it_code_of_user AND r.user_id = a.user_id AND r.system_role_id = a.system_role_id AND r.system_role = a.system_role WHERE a.alert_type IN (12, 32) AND a.alert_handle_status in ('Pending', 'Send') -- IMPORT 应用的数据不进入实时权限表，当前无法按本逻辑恢复，暂不处理 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM its_application_data iad WHERE iad.cmdb_id = a.cmdb_id AND iad.data_source = 'IMPORT' ) ),
-- 第二步：仅当实时 BPO 去重后恰好为一个 ItCode 时，从 UPP 推导其 CoC 类型 -- 多个 BPO、没有 BPO、UPP 未匹配或 coc_flag 非 Y/N 时，real_bpo_coc_type 均为 NULL enriched_alert_records AS ( SELECT ar.*, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(bpo_item))) FROM regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(ar.real_bpo, ''), '[,;]') AS bpo_item WHERE TRIM(bpo_item) != '' ) = 1 THEN ( SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(upp.coc_flag)) IN ('Y', 'N') THEN UPPER(TRIM(upp.coc_flag)) ELSE NULL END FROM regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(ar.real_bpo, ''), '[,;]') AS bpo_item LEFT JOIN ad_tb_upp_nature_2 upp ON LOWER(upp.user_name) = LOWER(TRIM(bpo_item)) WHERE TRIM(bpo_item) != '' LIMIT 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS real_bpo_coc_type FROM alert_records ar ),
-- 第三步：仅恢复“实时记录存在且 BPO 已变化”的记录 -- 复制告警快照中的审核字段，BPO/邮箱/应用级 BPO/CoC 改用实时数据 insert_changed AS ( INSERT INTO user_access_review ( id,sequence_number,uuid,cmdb_id,uar_id,app_name,it_code_of_user,email,user_name,user_real_name,system_role_id,system_role,role_description,role_valid_to,country,department,user_id,user_id_valid_to,user_id_lock,access_label,line_manager_band_ed_flag,line_manager_level_code,dept,line_manager,line_manager_email,it_code_of_bpo, bpo,bpo_email,user_coc_type,bpo_coc_type,bpo_update_by,bpo_update_time,app_bpo,app_bpo_email,backup_bpo,backup_bpo_email,backup_bpo_band_ed_flag,bpo_band_ed_flag,app_bpo_band_ed_flag,leit_system_name,leit_system_id,access_review_decision,first_line_manager,second_line_manager,audit_trail,authorization_technical_name,authorization_description,authorization_valid_to,overall_send_status,current_round,delete_flag, line_manager_review_status, line_managers_review_decision, line_manager_review_itcode, line_manager_review_time, bpo_review_status, bpo_review_decision, bpo_review_itcode, bpo_review_time, update_by, update_time, create_by, create_time ) SELECT id,sequence_number,uuid,cmdb_id,uar_id,app_name,it_code_of_user,email,user_name,user_real_name,system_role_id,system_role,role_description,role_valid_to,country,department,user_id,user_id_valid_to,user_id_lock,access_label,line_manager_band_ed_flag,line_manager_level_code,dept,line_manager,line_manager_email,it_code_of_bpo, REPLACE(real_bpo, ',', ';'), REPLACE(real_bpo_email, ',', ';'), user_coc_type,real_bpo_coc_type,bpo_update_by,bpo_update_time, real_app_bpo,real_app_bpo_email,backup_bpo,backup_bpo_email,backup_bpo_band_ed_flag,bpo_band_ed_flag,app_bpo_band_ed_flag,leit_system_name,leit_system_id,access_review_decision,first_line_manager,second_line_manager,audit_trail,authorization_technical_name,authorization_description,authorization_valid_to,overall_send_status,current_round,delete_flag, line_manager_review_status, line_managers_review_decision, line_manager_review_itcode, line_manager_review_time, bpo_review_status, bpo_review_decision, bpo_review_itcode, bpo_review_time, 'BPO_ALERT_REVERT', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'ALERT_REVERT', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM enriched_alert_records WHERE real_data IS NOT NULL AND bpo_changed = true ),
-- 第四步：建立本次成功恢复的告警 ID 与目标状态映射 -- 未匹配实时数据或 BPO 未变化的告警不会进入该集合 mark_status AS ( SELECT id, 'Completed' AS new_status FROM enriched_alert_records WHERE real_data IS NOT NULL AND bpo_changed = true )
-- 第五步：只将已恢复记录对应的有效告警更新为 Completed UPDATE user_access_review_alert SET alert_handle_status = ms.new_status, update_by = 'JOB', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM mark_status ms WHERE user_access_review_alert.id = ms.id AND user_access_review_alert.alert_type IN (12, 32) AND user_access_review_alert.alert_handle_status in ('Pending', 'Send');
